summary: Duplicates the open file handle of slot a1 into a newly allocated slot via DuplicateHandle under per-file critical sections, clears the source status flag's bit 4 on success, and returns the new slot index or -1 with a TLS error code.

operations.description: Entry guard: a1 < uNumber and the status byte at dword_8D4920[a1>>5] + 36*(a1&0x1F) + 4 has bit 0 set (slot open); otherwise take the guard-failure path.
CriticalSectionEnterWithLazyInit(a1) enters the per-file critical section for the source slot.
Save the current source slot status byte into v2 for the later flag update.
sub_595801() allocates a new free file slot index; -1 signals allocation failure.
On allocation failure set TLS error 24 via TLSOffsetGetter, TLS errno 0 via TLSOffsetGetter_afd8, leave the source slot critical section, and return -1.
GetCurrentProcess and sub_595A1F(a1) retrieve the source handle for slot a1.

DuplicateHandle duplicates the source handle into TargetHandle (inheritable, DUPLICATE_SAME_ACCESS); on success sub_595924(v3, TargetHandle) stores it into the new slot and LastError is 0, otherwise LastError = GetLastError().
On DuplicateHandle failure capture GetLastError() as LastError.
FileCriticalSectionLeave(v3) then FileCriticalSectionLeave(a1) release both slot critical sections.
If no error, clear bit 4 of the new slot status byte (v2 & 0xEF) at dword_8D4920[v3>>5] + 36*(v3&0x1F) + 4 and return the new slot index v3.
On error ErrorIDLookupTable(LastError) raises the mapped error before the function returns -1.
Guard-failure path: set TLS error 9 via TLSOffsetGetter and TLS errno 0 via TLSOffsetGetter_afd8.

unresolved: Purpose of status byte bit 4 (cleared via v2 & 0xEF on successful duplicate) is not labelled in packet evidence.
